contexts.text: His quiver () = the doctrine of good and truth.
The weapons for hunting, which wore quiver, bow, and arrows, = the doctrinal things of truth.
Take thy... quiver, and thy bow () = the doctrinal things of good which (Esau) had.
In His quiver hath he hidden me () = the Word.

As these truths have such power, it is said, Blessed is the man who hath filled his quiver with them (). A quiver, here, has a similar signification to a bow, namely, doctrine from the Word. AE 695:18. AE 724:10.
